title: tag set
description: A tag set (PLAN_0.8.0 D1, RFC-032 step 6): data/tags/<dataset_id>/<set>/tags.json. The failure modes tagged on arms' outputs for a dataset's items, from one failure-mode list; never edited once written. Its id is `<dataset_id>/<set>`.

dataset_id.description: Equals the folder above the set's.

failure_modes.description: The failure-mode list the tags are named from (data/failure-modes/<id>.yaml).
